reception: Reception of the construct divides between the project's orbit and the dataflow community. Within StreamIt, teleport messaging is exercised by application studies — stream programming for image and video compression, image-based motion estimation — and a sizable share of the citing record is the project's own. Outside it, the closest engagement comes from Edward A. Lee's group: Bui, Patel, and Lee adopt the sdep formalism to check circular dependencies in distributed stream programs, and Bui's dissertation on scheduling stream programs extends it. Elsewhere the paper is described more than used — SoC-C differentiates its own treatment of control in embedded software, and many citations recount the mechanism in detail without building on it.
